recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining active-source defect for FHIR-9167 without reopening the broader Break the Glass guidance that later Security WG work already reorganized.
issue_request: FHIR-9167 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Security WG change asking AuditEvent to make recording a break-glass event more obvious by adding an AuditEvent example, pointing the common-scenarios event-code table to it, and updating related security break-glass guidance.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by October 2019 commits that added the break-glass AuditEvent example, the common-scenarios row, and security-page links. The current source also lists the example in the AuditEvent examples list and retains the Break the Glass guidance on security.html after later page reorganization.
additional_context: FHIR-9166 was resolved as a duplicate of FHIR-9167. Later FHIR-53885 moved the standalone Break the Glass material from security-labels.html to security.html, so the current absence of that section on security-labels.html is intentional. A 2022 DICOM-link conversion preserved incorrect href anchors for the Break-Glass row while leaving the visible 110113 and 110127 labels correct.
reconciliation: Changed source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml to link DICOM Security Alert code 110113 to DCM_110113 and Emergency Override Started code 110127 to DCM_110127. No other source edits were needed because the example, example list, security-page AuditEvent pointer, and OperationOutcome pointer are already present in current build-scope source.
source_changes: source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml: corrected the Break-Glass started row href for DICOM 110113 from DCM_110114 to DCM_110113.
source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml: corrected the Break-Glass started row href for DICOM 110127 from DCM_110122 to DCM_110127.
